scope: Historical operations supported by task74 sources and task76/task78 validation; G-ALLOWED entries are not Fontana models.

domain_types.carrier: finite alphabet member or opaque cue identifier
cyclic offset of a rotatable component
what a user can read or perceive
learned association held by a person

operations.description: Choose a symbol, position, or pointer-addressed item without conflating choice with physical movement.
preconditions: address is valid in the model topology
operations.state_effect: none for retrieval selection; placement choices are recorded by place
operations.observable_effect: selected item becomes available to the user
composition_rules: may precede place or observe only with an addressable state
limitations: F07 pointer selection is not F08 placement

operations.description: Move one declared rotatable layer through an allowed cyclic displacement.
preconditions: step is allowed by the profile
operations.observable_effect: a different symbol may meet the reading reference
knowledge_requirements: zero, direction, layout, and step rule
operations.reversibility: inverse step exists only on an unrestricted cyclic profile
operations.error_behavior: undeclared coupling or step is rejected
composition_rules: parallel rotation needs disjoint declared layers
invariants: does not create a message or imply a cipher
limitations: F10 independent bands are only H-profile behavior

operations.description: Establish a shared reference at which configured components are read.
preconditions: a reading reference and compatible component geometry exist
operations.state_effect: none when reading; F10 profile writes orientations before observation
operations.error_behavior: missing reference yields an ambiguity set

operations.description: Associate a symbol or opaque cue with a physical position.
preconditions: position is writable and symbol is permitted
operations.state_effect: occupies or replaces one declared location
operations.observable_effect: the location visibly contains the item
operations.determinism: deterministic after the user chooses inputs
operations.reversibility: remove restores vacancy only where removal is modeled
composition_rules: may be followed by traversal or indexed lookup only in the same model

operations.description: Read positions in a declared physical path and produce an ordered observation.
preconditions: path belongs to the device topology
start, direction, and boundary are known
operations.reversibility: the reverse path is a distinct convention, not an automatic historical operation
composition_rules: only follows storage in a topology with an attested path
invariants: geometry may distort while traversal order survives
limitations: F10 route has no frozen traversal claim

operations.description: Resolve an index convention to an addressable physical position.
preconditions: index convention is supplied and index is occupied or declared
operations.error_behavior: unknown or absent index yields missing/ambiguous result
composition_rules: may precede lookup in F11 only
invariants: number labels do not imply arithmetic content
limitations: exact historical cue mapping is not frozen

operations.description: Emit an opaque cue at a profile-defined temporal condition.
operations.state_effect: the clock transition is modeled separately from emitted cue
composition_rules: does not provide a literal decoder
invariants: signal is not the remembered message
limitations: drive and historical calibration are unresolved

operations.description: Use a learned human-memory mapping to turn an opaque cue into a retrieved intention.
preconditions: user has learned the relevant association
operations.observable_effect: none beyond a possible user response
operations.error_behavior: unlearned cue is cue-only, not a failed literal decode
composition_rules: requires signal or another cue source

operations.description: Advance a cyclic trigger regime so that configured cues can recur.
preconditions: profile has a cyclic temporal transition
composition_rules: signal is enabled only at emitting states
invariants: periodicity is a state-space property, not a universal operation law
limitations: does not establish a physical drive

operations.description: Combine an ordered set of observed symbols into one literal sequence.
operations.reversibility: decomposition preserves order under the same convention
operations.error_behavior: unordered observations cannot be composed literally
composition_rules: derived lookup requires traverse/align before compose
limitations: not a universal decoder for cues

derived_operations.minimality: none of the three replaces the others
association cannot be eliminated without treating cue as literal content

compositions.precondition: frozen F01 profile supplies rings, radius, order, and length
frozen core supplies ordered spiral topology and declared path
known index convention and occupied slot
R0 temporal profile and learned mapping
requires a future M-RESTRICTED model with both address systems
association must receive an explicit Cue conversion in an M-model
signal requires an emitting temporal state; no input is provided

laws.statement: rotate(a) then rotate(b) = rotate(a+b mod n)
laws.scope: one F01 ring or F07 R0 wheel with declared cyclic modulus
laws.counterexample: F10 R1 suffix coupling changes more than one band

laws.statement: traverse after place is generally not equal to place after traverse
laws.counterexample: placing a symbol after observation cannot alter the emitted sequence

laws.statement: signal alone cannot recover a RetrievedItem
laws.counterexample: untrained and wrong-map trials return no correct intention

laws.statement: all primitives compose into a single historical encoder/decoder
laws.counterexample: F11 index and F12 association require incompatible retrieval relations
